notes.title: Cats Adventure Playtest v0.2 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! The Playtest v0.2 version of Cats Adventure is now live. This update brings multiple optimizations and new content, aiming to deliver a smoother and richer gaming experience! 🎮✨

🔧 Update Details

✅ Audio Optimization  
- Comprehensive sound effect adjustments for more impactful combat and immersive environments!  
- Improved skill sound effects for more exciting battle experiences!  

🎭 New Heroes Arrive  
- Multiple new heroes are now available, each with unique skill mechanics - come experience their power!  

🐞 Bug Fixes  
- Fixed scene stuttering issues for smoother performance!  
- Resolved abnormal skill effect display bugs.  
- Other known issues addressed for improved stability!  

Your feedback is very important!
We attach great importance to the opinions of players! After experiencing the Playtest, please contact us in the Steam discussion forum or through the following methods to share your thoughts and suggestions. Your feedback will help us create better games! 
Feedback form: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wvvrCmceTfME1oMOaaGXl9EC35zEbnsa1UuXP7S9IgU/edit?hl=zh-cn&gid=0#gid=0
We will provide free keys for the official version of Cats Adventure game to players who provide effective bug feedback!
discard： https://discord.gg/q5u3USXR
You can also watch our videos anytime
Youtube： https://www.youtube.com/ @Catsadventure-f9w
 
Share your experience!
If you enjoy Cats Adventure, don't forget to share your game screenshots or videos on social media and tag them with # Cats Adventure and # Steamplaytest, allowing more players to join our adventure journey!

Thank you for your support!
Cats Adventure Development Team

notes.title: The Cats Adventure playtest is online
notes.content:
The Cats Adventure playtest is online! Come and experience it!
 
Dear players,
The playtest version of Cats Adventure is now officially available on Steam!
 
Cats Adventure is a casual pigeon action adventure game that combines randomly generated monsters, a rich prop system, and thrilling battles. you will experience:
Unique gameplay: A meat pigeon adventure survival game in 3D scenes. Purchase weapons and props to form mods, and finally defeat the boss to successfully complete the level.
Exciting content: The version includes 3 heroes with different experiences and initial weapons, with 3 difficulty levels (difficulty 0, difficulty 1, difficulty 2) open
Future expectations: Massive heroes, progress system, more challenging difficulty, cooler weapons, and more props to be released soon
 
How to Participate
1. Visit the Steam page of Cats Adventure playtest:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3415300/Cats_adventure/  
2. Click the "playtest" button to experience it for free immediately!
3. Don't forget to add the game to your wish list, support us, and get the official version online notification as soon as possible!
 
Your feedback is very important!
We attach great importance to the opinions of players! After experiencing the demo, please contact us in the Steam discussion forum or through the following methods to share your thoughts and suggestions. Your feedback will help us create better games! At present, there are still some minor bugs in the sound effects, and we will optimize them in the next version.
Feedback form: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wvvrCmceTfME1oMOaaGXl9EC35zEbnsa1UuXP7S9IgU/edit?hl=zh-cn&gid=0#gid=0
